answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The knoll holds work receipts rather than names, so the oasis of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the signal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
